note: Default v3 templates from the evaluation harness. {condition_context}, {road_context_label} and {candidates} are filled per pair by front2back.prompts.build_prompt. If resources/paper_prompts.json exists (exported from the evaluation database), it takes precedence.

templates.rgb_full:
You are evaluating an asymmetric front-to-rear vehicle re-identification benchmark.
{condition_context}
Task: identify which rear candidate is the same physical vehicle as the front target.
Use the front target box labeled T and the rear candidate boxes labeled C1, C2, etc.
Also estimate the distance in meters from the rear camera to the selected candidate.
Road context: {road_context_label}.
Detector-generated class labels, detector confidence scores, and text bbox coordinates are intentionally withheld.
Rear candidates:
{candidates}
Return JSON only using the required schema.
templates.front_crop:
You are evaluating an asymmetric front-to-rear vehicle re-identification benchmark.
{condition_context}
Task: match the cropped front target vehicle to one rear candidate.
Use the cropped target image and the rear candidate boxes labeled C1, C2, etc.
Also estimate the distance in meters from the rear camera to the selected candidate.
Road context: {road_context_label}.
Detector-generated class labels, detector confidence scores, and text bbox coordinates are intentionally withheld.
Rear candidates:
{candidates}
Return JSON only using the required schema.
templates.front_mask:
You are evaluating an asymmetric front-to-rear vehicle re-identification benchmark.
{condition_context}
Task: match the front target segmentation mask to one rear candidate.
Use shape, pose, silhouette, and rear scene evidence. Do not rely on color or texture in the mask.
Also estimate the distance in meters from the rear camera to the selected candidate.
Road context: {road_context_label}.
Detector-generated class labels, detector confidence scores, and text bbox coordinates are intentionally withheld.
Rear candidates:
{candidates}
Return JSON only using the required schema.
